correctness.rationale: Dyadic bounded-type spacing yields inverse-square-small-divisor O(2^(2r)) for dyadic block 2^r, so the Sobolev-weighted sum converges exactly for s>1 and Fourier CS gives a continuous real solution. Endpoint Fourier series at every fourth even continued-fraction denominator has delta comparable to 1/q, so square-summable coefficients produce H^1 data, Fejer means of positive coefficients diverge, and rotation ergodicity excludes continuous transfers. Matching omega(h) bounds use signed trigonometric increments and geometric tail estimates. Nonincreasing block coefficients give arbitrary gauge o(hL(1/h)).
